errors.notFound: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or you don't have access.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.versionConflict: This record was changed somewhere else.
errors.internal: Something unexpected happened. Try again; if it persists, share this code with us.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.

rules.BR-ACC-001: A new account can't be created with this email. If you have an account, sign in or reset your password.

ui.offline: No connection. Your changes may not be saved.

verify.subject: Aysly: verify your email address
verify.body:
Hi {name},

Open this link to verify your email address (valid for 24 hours):
{url}

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Aysly: reset your password
reset.body:
Hi {name},

Open this link to reset your password (valid for 30 minutes, single use):
{url}

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email; your password won't change.

passwordChanged.subject: Aysly: your password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
Hi {name},

The password for your Aysly account was just changed and your sessions on other devices were signed out.

If you didn't make this change, reset your password right away with "Forgot password".

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If your email is registered, we've sent a password reset link. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out on all devices. You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

reasons.too_short: Password must be at least 10 characters.
reasons.too_common: This password is too common; choose another one.

auth.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
